how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed Pro-forma (Annexure) and attach supporting documents.
Send it to Shri Ajay Kumar, Under Secretary, DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, 5th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhavan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.
Send it within 3 weeks of publication of the advertisement in the 'Employment News'.
Catalogue the application with numbered pages and send it as a single unit, not in parts.
Applicants working in Central/State Govt/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel, with one copy sent in advance.
Make sure it reaches by 8 December 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications, applications without supporting documents, advance applications not followed by applications forwarded through proper channel, or applications received after the last date will be summarily rejected

rows.department_of_empowerment_of_persons_wit: Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities
Pay scale and allowances as admissible to the Secretary to the Government of India

Graduation from a recognized university; preference for a recognized degree or diploma in social work, law, management, human rights, rehabilitation or education of persons with disabilities. At least 25 years of experience in a Group 'A' level post or as a senior functionary, including at least 3 years in rehabilitation or empowerment of persons with disabilities.

Shri Ajay Kumar, Under Secretary, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, 5th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhavan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003

content_sections.heading: DEPwD Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 16-08/2014-DRC/CCPD(Pt.Vol.II) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DEPwD notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduation from a recognized university; Preference to persons with a recognized degree or diploma in social work or law or management or human rights or rehabilitation or education of persons with disabilities Experience: At least twenty-five years in a Group 'A' level post in the Central Government, a State Government, a Public Sector Undertaking, a semi-Government or an autonomous body dealing with disability related matters or social sector, or as a senior level functionary in registered national and international voluntary organizations in the field of disability or social development; out of the 25 years, at least three years in the field of rehabilitation or empowerment of persons with disabilities Age limit: Maximum 60 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Applicants in Central or State Government service must seek retirement from that service before appointment Candidates who applied for the post of CCPD earlier must apply afresh Desirable: Preference for a recognized degree or diploma in social work, law, management, human rights, rehabilitation or education of persons with disabilities

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay scale and allowances as admissible to the Secretary to the Government of India; no amount printed. Term of office is three years from the date of assuming office, or till age sixty-five years, whichever is earlier Salary is reduced by the amount of pension (and commuted value of any commuted portion) for a retired Government servant or serving employee of a Government-funded institution or autonomous body in receipt of pension

content_sections.heading: How Will DEPwD Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Search-cum-Selection Committee may identify and recommend any other person, based on merit, who has not applied Search-cum-Selection Committee is free to identify and recommend any other person, based on merit, who has not applied

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proof of date of birth (10th certificate/DOB certificate) Education certificate(s) Present pay certificate (if applicable) Employer's/organization's registration certificate for NGO or other national or international organization experience Copies of APARs for the last five years (if applicable) Vigilance clearance (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, applications without supporting documents, advance applications not followed by applications forwarded through proper channel, or applications received after the last date will be summarily rejected

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DEPwD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for DEPwD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure (pro-forma of application) to the circular; also downloadable from the DEPwD website) and send it to Shri Ajay Kumar, Under Secretary, Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, 5th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhavan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003, by post, to reach by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for DEPwD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 60 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale and allowances as admissible to the Secretary to the Government of India.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduation from a recognized university; preference for a recognized degree or diploma in social work, law, management, human rights, rehabilitation or education of persons with disabilities. At least 25 years of experience in a Group 'A' level post or as a senior functionary, including at least 3 years in rehabilitation or empowerment of persons with disabilities.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants in Central or State Government service must seek retirement from that service before appointment. Candidates who applied for the post of CCPD earlier must apply afresh.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Search-cum-Selection Committee may identify and recommend any other person, based on merit, who has not applied. Search-cum-Selection Committee is free to identify and recommend any other person, based on merit, who has not applied.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Term of office is three years from the date of assuming office, or till age sixty-five years, whichever is earlier. Salary is reduced by the amount of pension (and commuted value of any commuted portion) for a retired Government servant or serving employee of a Government-funded institution or autonomous body in receipt of pension.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Proof of date of birth (10th certificate/DOB certificate); Education certificate(s); Present pay certificate (if applicable); Employer's/organization's registration certificate for NGO or other national or international organization experience; Copies of APARs for the last five years (if applicable); Vigilance clearance (if applicable).
